summary: Backend-only testing of refactored /api/geocode (Photon primary + Nominatim fallback + 24h Mongo cache) and regression smoke of /api/ and /api/nearby. 7/7 pytest cases passed in 4.84s.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding a lightweight test-only header or admin endpoint to confirm geocode_cache hits vs misses (currently inferred via latency only).
server.py is becoming large; splitting geocode/nearby/ai/auth into routers would improve maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Cache entries for 'paris', 'shanghai', 'tokyo tower' were populated in geocode_cache as a side-effect of testing (24h TTL).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Geocode endpoint verified working across paris/shanghai/tokyo tower, empty query returns []. Cached second call for 'paris' served in <3s and matched first-call payload exactly. /api/ and /api/nearby regression smoke passed (paris nearby returned >=5 items including landmark/event/news categories). Full regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_localer_backend.py was not re-run this iteration — invoke it only if other endpoints change.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/geocode previously called Nominatim directly without caching/UA throttling, hitting HTTP 429 and returning [], so the frontend search bar showed no suggestions. Fix (now verified): endpoint queries Photon (photon.komoot.io) first, falls back to Nominatim on failure, and caches results in Mongo collection geocode_cache for 24h — eliminating 429s on repeat queries and dramatically reducing latency on cache hits.
